regressionNote: story-044 changed the abstract deposit() signature to return uint256 creditedPrincipal. No logic changes; purely a signature update to propagate the return value defined in IYieldStrategy.

noUnboundedLoops.notes: No loops. _uint256ToString uses a while loop bounded by digit count (max ~77 for uint256, practical bound).

checkedArithmetic.notes: Solidity 0.8+; no unchecked blocks or assembly.

reentrancyGuarded.notes: Both totalWithdrawal and skimSurplus use nonReentrant. deposit() and withdraw() are abstract (guards expected in concrete implementations). emergencyWithdraw does NOT have nonReentrant but delegates to _emergencyWithdraw which is also abstract.

accessControlled.notes: All admin functions are onlyOwner. pause() is onlyPauser. unpause() accepts either owner or pauser. skimSurplus is onlyAuthorizedWithdrawer.

pauseMechanism.notes: Inherits OZ Pausable. pause() requires onlyPauser. unpause() requires owner or pauser. IPausable interface implemented.

localFindings.description: Uses `this.balanceOf(token, client)` — an external self-call — to read the client's balance. This resolves correctly (balanceOf delegates to principalOf in concrete implementations) but pays the external-call gas premium unnecessarily. No security impact: balanceOf is a view function, the nonReentrant guard on the caller (totalWithdrawal) only blocks re-entrant state-changing calls, and the mutex state is correctly checked.
localFindings.recommendation: Define and call a virtual internal `_principalOf(address token, address client)` helper that concrete contracts override, avoiding the external dispatch overhead and making the call intent explicit.

summary: Abstract base contract providing security scaffolding for yield strategy adapters. Supplies: EnumerableSet-backed authorized-client registry (prevents duplicate skims), authorized-withdrawer registry, per-client set-aside buffer config, IPausable integration, two-phase timelocked totalWithdrawal, and reentrancy/pause guards. Concrete contracts (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy, ERC4626YieldStrategy) override the abstract deposit/withdraw/_emergencyWithdraw/_totalWithdraw/_skimSurplus hooks.

keyStateVariables.name: _authorizedClients
keyStateVariables.invariant: No duplicate entries guaranteed by EnumerableSet. Membership check is O(1). Only owner can add/remove. Used as the canonical skim-target set.

keyStateVariables.name: setAsideBufferSize
keyStateVariables.invariant: Value is always 0-100 (percent). Validated by setSetAsideBuffer.

keyStateVariables.name: withdrawalStates
keyStateVariables.invariant: State machine: None/Expired -> Initiated -> Executable -> None. States are auto-advanced by _updateWithdrawalStatus based on block.timestamp. Expired resets automatically to allow re-initiation.

externalEntryPoints.notes: bufferPercent must be 0–100. Emits SetAsideBufferSet with old and new values.
No nonReentrant and no whenNotPaused — intentional for emergency access. Delegates to _emergencyWithdraw() virtual.

State machine: first call initiates 24h wait, second call (after 24h, within 72h total) executes. Expired state resets automatically. State is zeroed before _totalWithdraw() virtual call (CEI pattern).

externalEntryPoints.function: skimSurplus(address token, address recipient) returns (uint256 underlyingReceived)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Passes _authorizedClients.values() (snapshot) to _skimSurplus. Empty client set is a no-op (returns 0). Return value is amount delivered to recipient, reduced by set-aside buffers.

externalEntryPoints.function: deposit(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient) returns (uint256 creditedPrincipal)
externalEntryPoints.notes: REGRESSION CHANGE (story-044): signature now includes return value. Abstract; concrete contracts must add onlyAuthorizedClient and nonReentrant.

externalEntryPoints.function: withdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient)

externalCalls.notes: External self-call in _initiateWithdrawal (line 468). View-only, no reentrancy risk, but incurs external call gas cost.

trustAssumptions: Owner is trusted for admin operations (setClient, setWithdrawer, emergencyWithdraw, totalWithdrawal, setPauser).
Pauser address is a trusted protocol component or multisig.
Authorized withdrawers are trusted protocol components (e.g., SurplusYieldAccumulator).
block.timestamp is reliable within the bounds of miner manipulation (practical ~15 second window; negligible for 24h/48h timelock thresholds).
